title: Web Team Lead (Laravel)
description:
Lead a team of Laravel developers to plan, develop, and maintain scalable web applications using Laravel and modern PHP practices  

  



Architect and optimize database schemas (MySQL/PostgreSQL), ensuring high performance and reliability  

  



Conduct code reviews and enforce coding standards, best practices, and security measures across the team  

  



Collaborate closely with UI/UX designers, front\-end developers, and project managers to deliver high\-quality solutions  

  



Design and develop RESTful APIs and integrate third\-party services (Google, Facebook, AWS, payment gateways, etc.)  

  



Manage project timelines, delegate tasks, and ensure the successful delivery of features in Agile/Scrum environments  

  



Perform performance tuning, security hardening, and DevOps enhancements  

  



Act as a technical mentor to junior developers and provide training as required  

  



Communicate with clients and stakeholders to understand requirements and provide technical solutions  

  



Ensure CI/CD pipelines are effectively implemented and maintained  

  



Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making skills  

  



Ability to lead, coach, and motivate a team  

  



  

  

### **Requirements**

Expertise in Laravel, PHP (OOP \& MVC), and MySQL/PostgreSQL  

  



Proficient in front\-end technologies: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, jQuery, and AJAX  

  



Experience with JavaScript frameworks like Vue.js or React.js  

  



Strong understanding of RESTful API and GraphQL design principles  

  



Proficiency in Git, GitHub/GitLab workflows  

  



Familiarity with caching systems (Redis, Memcached)  

  



Experience with Docker, AWS, and containerized deployments (Kubernetes is a plus)  

  



Knowledge of authentication and security: OAuth, JWT, CSRF, XSS protection  

  



Understanding of TDD and automated testing tools (PHPUnit, Dusk)  

  



Hands\-on experience with CI/CD tools and pipelines  

  



Experience or familiarity with CMS platforms like WordPress, Joomla, or Drupal (preferred)

title: Senior Specialist IT
description:
Exciting opportunity for an experienced **Windchill****professional** with strong expertise in **Windchill****customization,****integrations,****APIs,****workflows,****and****PLM****solutions**. We are looking for candidates with **3\+****years****of****Windchill****development****experience** and a solid understanding of Windchill architecture, best practices, and product lifecycle management processes.  

Your role  

Key responsibilities in your new role

  

* Design, develop, test, and deploy custom Windchill applications, integrations, and plugins using Java, to meet business requirements and improve product lifecycle management
* Develop custom APIs using Windchill's Java\-based API, to integrate with other systems, services, or applications, ensuring seamless data exchange and functionality
* Implement business logic, workflows, and rules using Windchill's Java\-based scripting engine, to automate and streamline product development, manufacturing, and quality processes.
* Ensure high\-quality code, following best practices, coding standards, and Windchill's development guidelines, to maintain scalability, performance, and maintainability
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including business stakeholders, project managers, and other developers, to ensure successful project delivery and effective communication
* Stay current with Windchill's latest releases, features, and best practices, applying this knowledge to improve custom applications, integrations, and plugin

  

Your profile  

Qualifications and skills to help you succeed

  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
* At least 3 years of experience in Java development for Windchill
* Proficiency in Java, including Java 8 or later, with experience in Java\-based development, debugging, and troubleshooting
* In\-depth knowledge of Windchill's architecture, APIs, and development tools
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment, prioritize tasks, and meet deadlines
* Familiarity with DevOps practices and tools, such as continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD)
* Windchill Certifications \- Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a global team environment
* Experience with Agile development methodologies, including Scrum or Kanban

title: Python Backend Developer
description:
**Python Backend Developer**

We are seeking a Python Backend Developer to join our development team. This role is primarily backend\-focused and involves designing, building, and maintaining scalable Python\-based systems and APIs. The ideal candidate should also have strong foundational knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to effectively integrate backend services with frontend interfaces and handle basic UI requirements when needed.

**Experience Required:** Minimum 2 years of professional experience in Python backend development.

**Key Responsibilities**

*Backend Development (Python)*

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable Python backend applications
* Build secure and high\-performance RESTful APIs and backend services
* Work with relational and/or NoSQL databases and optimize queries
* Integrate third\-party services, external APIs, and internal systems
* Ensure backend code quality, security, performance, and scalability
* Debug, refactor, and improve existing backend systems
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to define and implement backend requirements

*Cloud \& DevOps*

* Deploy and manage applications on AWS (EC2, Lambda)
* Work with Azure or Google APIs as required by the project
* Monitor production environments and resolve performance or stability issues

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* Minimum 2 years of hands\-on experience in Python backend development
* Strong proficiency in Python and backend frameworks (e.g., Django, Flask, or FastAPI)
* Experience building and consuming RESTful APIs
* Solid understanding of relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL) and/or NoSQL databases (e.g., MongoDB)
* Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for frontend integration
* Experience with AWS services (EC2, Lambda) or similar cloud platforms
* Familiarity with version control systems (Git)
* Strong debugging, problem\-solving, and communication skills
* Ability to work collaboratively in a cross\-functional team environment

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with Azure or Google Cloud APIs
* Familiarity with containerization (Docker) or CI/CD pipelines
* Exposure to frontend frameworks (React, Vue, or similar)

Pay: ₹100,000\.00 \- ₹300,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person
